segments.name: Risk
segments.description: Group business area that now also includes a small commercial healthcare products portfolio, reported with its own revenue and profit.
segments.evidence: Also, a small portfolio of commercial healthcare products, previously reported in Scientific, Technical & Medical, is now reported in Risk.

segments.name: Scientific, Technical & Medical
segments.description: Business area reported separately from print, with its own revenue and adjusted operating profit disclosed.
segments.evidence: Consequently, Risk, Scientific, Technical & Medical and Legal now exclude print and print-related activities, consistent with financial information provided to the Board.

segments.name: Legal
segments.description: Legal business area reported separately, excluding print and print-related activities, with revenue and adjusted operating profit disclosed.
segments.evidence: Consequently, Risk, Scientific, Technical & Medical and Legal now exclude print and print-related activities, consistent with financial information provided to the Board.

segments.name: Exhibitions
segments.description: Business area reported alongside the others, with revenue and adjusted operating profit shown separately in the group segment tables.

segments.name: Print & print-related activities
segments.description: Print and print-related activities reported as their own segment, separate from the group four business areas.
segments.evidence: From 2025, revenue and profit for print and print-related activities are managed and reported separately from the four business areas.
